summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the package-local file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line ~727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (string-array rotator function `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers, encoded literal array) that is never referenced from the library's `main` entry — only the preinstall-launched Bun process ever loads it. The rest of the package ships a legitimate-looking slate-react build under dist/ as cover, and the declared git repository (github.com/CorentinAndre/slate) is unrelated to the @ornikar scope or to the upstream ianstormtaylor/slate project. Installing this package causes the obfuscated payload to execute on the installer's host under an alien runtime that Node-based tooling does not observe, with no functional relationship to the advertised React rich-text-editor fork.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
